crossRefs.note: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

translations.web: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.
translations.bsb: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
